meta.title: Borrow Swiss francs against crypto, gold or shares | Frankencoin
meta.description: Mint ZCHF against BTC, ETH, tokenized gold or Swiss shares and keep your exposure. Live loan-to-value and interest for every collateral, and one worked example.

hero.title: Borrow francs.|Keep your BTC, ETH, gold or shares.
hero.subtitle: Lock collateral, mint Swiss francs, repay by maturity to get the collateral back. No credit check: the terms are on-chain and fixed when you open the position.

items.title: BTC and ETH
items.description: Wrapped and staked versions such as WBTC, cbBTC, WETH and wstETH.

items.title: Tokenized gold
items.description: Gold tokens such as XAUt and PAXG.

items.title: Tokenized shares
items.description: Swiss company shares issued on-chain, and tokenized index funds.

rates.title: Live terms per collateral
rates.subtitle: The best open terms right now. The app shows your exact numbers before you sign.

defs.ltv: Liquidation price divided by today's market price: the most you can borrow per franc of collateral.
defs.rate: Yearly rate on the amount you repay, paid upfront for the whole term.
defs.maturity: Latest date to repay or roll over before the position can be liquidated.

example.title: One position,|start to finish.
example.subtitle: Example terms: 20% reserve, one-year maturity, 50% loan-to-value. The reserve, rate and maturity differ per collateral; see the table above.

rows.label: Collateral locked
rows.note: Stays in your own position contract, visible on-chain.

rows.label: Francs minted
rows.note: 50% of the collateral's value. The liquidation price is set at half today's market price.

rows.label: Francs you receive
rows.note: 10,000 minus 2,000 retained reserve minus 500 interest for one year, paid upfront.

rows.label: Amount to repay
rows.note: The minted amount minus the reserve, which the protocol keeps back and nets against your debt. You receive less than you owe because the interest is already paid.

rows.label: Maturity
rows.note: Repay any time before it to get the collateral back, or roll over to extend. After maturity the position can be liquidated.

rows.label: Liquidation
rows.note: If the collateral trades below the liquidation price, anyone can challenge the position and part of the collateral is auctioned. Add collateral or repay part of the debt to lower the risk.

example.note: The interest in the table is quoted on the amount you repay: here 500 / 8,000 = 6.25% a year.

faq.a: An Ethereum wallet with the collateral and some ETH for transaction fees. Positions live on Ethereum mainnet.

faq.q: Is there a credit check or KYC?
faq.a: No. The collateral is the only security, and nobody can deny you a position.
Whoever opened the original position proposed them, and FCS holders (Frankencoin Shares) could veto. When you borrow you clone those terms.

faq.q: Can I add collateral or repay part of the loan later?
faq.a: Yes. Both lower your liquidation risk. You can also roll a position over before maturity.

faq.q: My token is not listed. Can it be?
faq.a: Token issuers and holders can [propose a new collateral](/integrate/collateral).
